entries.meaning: I revere Hari, called Rāma: peaceful, eternal, immeasurable, stainless and the giver of liberation's peace; ceaselessly served by Brahmā, Śambhu and the serpent-lord; known through Vedānta and all-pervading; Lord of the world, teacher of the gods and human through māyā; the wellspring of compassion, finest of Raghu's line and crown-jewel of kings.
entries.note: Original close English rendering from the pinned Devanagari witness; editorial work awaiting independent review.

words: ceaselessly served by Brahmā, Śambhu and the serpent-lord

entries.meaning: Lord of Raghu's line, there is no other longing in this heart of mine—I speak the truth, and you are the inner Self of all. Foremost of Raghu's line, grant me wholehearted devotion and make my mind free from faults beginning with desire.
entries.note: Original close English rendering from the pinned Devanagari witness; editorial work awaiting independent review.

words: you are the inner Self of all
free from faults beginning with desire

entries.meaning: I bow to the wind-born Hanumān: abode of incomparable strength, body radiant like a golden mountain, fire to the forest of demons, foremost among the wise, repository of every virtue, lord of the vānaras and pre-eminent messenger of Raghupati.
entries.note: Original close English rendering of the pinned edition-specific reading; editorial work awaiting independent review.

words: whose body shines like a golden mountain
fire to the forest of demons
